note: Levels require an explicit Forever BaseLevel, a non-seasonal Classic reference corroborating a non-default level or priced starter ability, class-specific SkillRaceClassInfo, or a by-ID level (source forever-level-by-id, with its evidence). Uncorroborated seasonal/default level-one records are not assumed trainable. A row with no ClassMask takes its class skill line's class. Tiger's Fury 5217 is trained by ID though its only row is AcquireMethod 3 (levelAudit trainedById). Talents (spells defined in the class trait trees; Forever trains many Classic talents, so the Classic Talent table is not used), Revoke 1325499, taught with Salvation, and a few non-trainer spells by ID (talent effects, a form's passive, seasonal rune spells) are excluded. trainerChanges lists the spells trainers stopped or started teaching by server hotfix, which client data cannot show. talentChains lists the trained ranks of a spell whose rank 1 is a tree talent, each given the rank before it by the client's rank number (the client's SupercedesSpell is 0 on them), so they wait for the talent. rankChains lists every other trained rank above 1 the client gives no earlier rank, each given the rank of the same class, skill line and name one lower (a row, or with starting the rank 1 every character of the class starts with). heldPrev lists the ranks kept at 0 by ID, with why. Prices are non-seasonal Classic base-price references, not verified Forever quotes.
